newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Boston Chicken EPS view up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Boston Chicken EPS view up.

text.p: --Hanifen, Imhoff Inc said Wednesday it raised its fiscal 1997 earnings per share estimate on Boston Chicken Inc to $1.37 from $1.30 after the restaurant company recently reported slightly better-than-expected results for 1996.
--Analyst Christopher Weis in a report also set $1.77 as an EPS projection for fiscal 1998.
--"We expect systemwide average weekly sales to increase about four percent in 1997 as a result of new product introductions as well as increased media efficiencies for advertising," Weis noted.
